## Completing the Allied Platform

::: {.gold-line}
:::

Allied Scaffolding is the final piece of our integrated on-site services platform. By bringing scaffolding under the same management team as our crane operations and logistics coordination, we eliminate the coordination gaps that cause programme delays on complex projects.

We're building a scaffolding division that matches the safety standards, technology integration, and client focus that Allied Lifting and Allied Logistics are known for.

:::::
::::

#### System Scaffolding
Modern system scaffolding solutions for residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects. Fast erection, safe configuration, adaptable to complex geometries.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Tube & Fitting
Traditional tube and fitting scaffolding for bespoke access requirements. Experienced scaffolders delivering complex designs where system scaffolding cannot reach.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Temporary Roofing & Encapsulation
Weather protection and encapsulation solutions for projects requiring controlled environments. Integrated with crane operations for efficient installation.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Design & Engineering
In-house scaffold design capability with structural engineering sign-off. Coordinated with lifting plans to ensure safe and efficient erection sequences.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Inspection & Compliance
Regular scaffold inspections, NASC compliance, and handover documentation. All integrated into our digital reporting platform for full visibility.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Integrated Planning
Scaffolding programmes coordinated with crane schedules and logistics plans from day one — eliminating the coordination gaps that cause delays.

## The Integration Advantage {style="color: #FFFFFF;"}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

When your scaffolding, cranes, and logistics are managed by separate suppliers, coordination gaps are inevitable. Materials arrive before scaffolding is ready. Crane time is wasted waiting for scaffold adaptation. Access routes conflict with delivery schedules.

Allied Scaffolding eliminates these gaps by bringing scaffolding into the same integrated team that manages your crane operations and site logistics.
